name: cutover-runbook-check
description: Application migration cutover runbook check: reads the per-application cutover runbook a team follows on migration day, as JSON or as CSV with an application file, and reports what is missing or risky before the move: required phases with no step, change steps with no rollback step, no backup before the first data move, steps with no owner or no check of success, no go/no-go gate before the switch, unknown dependencies, dependency cycles and duplicate ids, a critical path longer than the downtime window, a rollback that does not fit what is left of it, a strategy of the 7 Rs that does not match the steps, and a missing business sign-off, data owner or communication plan, with minutes per phase and the critical path. Text, JSON, CSV and GitHub annotation output, exit codes for a pipeline, no dependencies.
author: INNERLUXES <info@innerluxes.dev>
